sv.title: Tydligt att S har gett upp
sv.summary: Magdalena Anderssons pressträff på tisdagen lät som ett avskedstal. Kanske inte till partiledarposten, än, men väl till regeringsbildningen 2026.

en.title: Clear that the Social Democrats have given up
en.summary: Magdalena Andersson's press conference on Tuesday sounded like a farewell speech. Perhaps not as party leader, not yet, but certainly as regards the government formation in 2026.
